text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the existing 9:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., Monday to Friday, parking prohibition on both sides of Conrad Avenue, between Hillcrest Drive and Tyrell Avenue, in order to generate additional on-street parking opportunities.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 9:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Conrad Avenue, between Hillcrest Drive and Tyrell Avenue.
